title: 50 Sea Otters Survived—Then Protected Carbon-Storing Kelp
hook: 50 sea otters survived, then helped protect carbon-storing kelp.
closing: Saving one predator can protect an entire coastline and its carbon.
question: Would you welcome otters nearby?

segments.say: Only 50 California sea otters remained. Fur trading nearly erased the population.
The population recovered to about 3,000. The comeback remains incomplete because the species is still threatened.
Otter-protected kelp can store 8.7 million metric tons of CO2 yearly. One predator shields a major carbon sink.
